plan.hypothesis: Stable COLMAP point ordering should make the initial Gaussian arrays and first weights identical across runs, allowing the seeded sampler experiment to be tested without HashMap traversal confounding it.
plan.change: Sort point IDs numerically before constructing initial position/color arrays; leave image producer, sampler seed, optimizer and GPU kernels unchanged.
plan.scope: Experimental Brush source binary only; both variants use single image producer, seeded weighted sampler and same trace instrumentation. Official binary and application unchanged.
plan.acceptance: Initial point order, first weight arrays and seeded sampler traces should match per scene. Whole-model identity remains an empirical check. No production adoption without quality and cost evidence.
plan.common_parser_fix: Read binary POINT3D_ID as little endian in both variants. Prior probe sorted byte-swapped internal IDs and is not included in this comparison.

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.
decision: Keep the little-endian point-ID correction and canonical initialization in the experimental patch. True point ID order repeats after sorting, but first weights and full models still differ. Quality is mixed across scenes, so the official installed engine is not replaced and no deterministic/quality/speed gain is claimed.

preliminary_probe.reason_excluded: Parser decoded IDs with wrong byte order; sorting those internal keys does not sort the original COLMAP IDs. Probe metrics are retained separately and excluded from final summary.
